item.title: Men’s basketball: Tommies fall at Omaha
item.description: A three-game winning streak for the St. Thomas men’s basketball team came to a close Thursday night as the Tommies lost their first Summit League game this season to a team not from North Dakota. A second-half rally fell short as St. Thomas lost 98-94 at Omaha for the Tommies’ third loss in Summit play. […]
